mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring additional triggers.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when FEDFUNDS has exceeded 4.5% for two months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in unemployment rate and payroll employment growth signal a labor market slowdown that reduces corporate profit expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The negative return signal fails when the interaction of UNRATE and PAYEMS decline occurs, with SPX 60-day returns positive in more than 55% of such cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, rising consumer credit (RSAFS) above its 12-month moving average indicates strong consumption, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS is above its 12-month moving average during late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past 3 months indicates robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days as corporate earnings expectations rise.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO has increased for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0% for three consecutive months, it triggers a central bank tightening response that depresses equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.0% for three months.

mechanism_narrative: During a labor market recovery phase, a decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.5% combined with rising payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals strong job growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 4.5% and PAYEMS is rising.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and consumer credit (RSAFS) indicate strong household demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days as corporate sales expectations improve.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS are increasing.
